description: PVCF publishes a fused vector inventory of photovoltaic infrastructure in China, updated through December 2025. The current Zenodo release is public under CC BY-NC 4.0 and lists a README plus a zipped vector dataset. Its article describes fusion of nine source maps with manual review and image-model checks, giving 10,290.15 square kilometres of mapped PV area. Coverage is China through December 2025. These footprints can locate solar assets in capacity-planning or hazard-exposure simulations after linking them to a network model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that mapped area is not installed electrical capacity, and disagreement among input maps is large in low-agreement regions. The release licence changed from CC BY 4.0 on an older Zenodo version to noncommercial CC BY-NC 4.0 on the current version; users should check which release they use. I read both own version metadata pages and manifests, without downloading the vector archive, testing classification accuracy or resolving the detailed geospatial file format.
